title: Not sure who this team is, but it doesn’t look like the Rays we know
text:
Not sure who this team is, but it doesn’t look like the Rays we know 
 Advertisement Viewpoints John Romano Sports Columnist Not sure who this team is, but it doesn’t look like the Rays we know Three losses into the World Series, Tampa Bay’s pitching has been a disappointment and the gloves have been uncharacteristically shaky.     .   Rays leftfielder Chandler Simpson settles into the 10-1 loss Monday night at Tropicana Field. [ JEFFEREE WOO | Times ] John Romano is the sports columnist, offering his opinion on all Tampa Bay sports franchises. Reach him at jromano@tampabay.com.
